description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointCollectionResult class, which extends AbstractEndpointResult and provides normalization functions for endpoint result collections in the OrangeHRM HRM system's API v2. It includes method overriding and references serialization-related classes.

classes.name: EndpointCollectionResult
classes.description: A class extending AbstractEndpointResult, used to normalize API collection results, handling object and array normalization based on the model class.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to normalize the collection result. Checks if the model class implements CollectionNormalizable and calls the appropriate normalization method accordingly.
